title: Settings

notif.title: Browser notifications
notif.desc: Get notified when a download finishes or fails
notif.telegram: Telegram notifications for operators are configured through server environment variables.
notif.reenable: To turn it back on, open your browser settings → Site Permissions → Notifications → allow this site.

data.title: Data & Storage
data.desc: How long each type of data is kept
data.exportHint: Export history: sign in → History → the Export CSV/JSON button.

temp.label: Downloaded files (not pinned)
temp.note: Deleted automatically after download. Pin to Archive to keep them.

pinned.label: Pinned files (Archive)
pinned.noteBoth: Free: {{free}}. Pro: {{pro}}. Pin again to extend.
pinned.noteDefault: When the pin expires the file is deleted; the metadata stays.

exportFree.label: History export (Free)
exportFree.note: Export CSV/JSON for the last 30 days.

exportPro.label: History export (Pro)
exportPro.note: Export CSV/JSON for the last 365 days.

meta.label: Archive metadata
meta.note: Descriptive data is kept even after the file expires.

access.title: API Access
access.header: Use the <c>{{header}}</c> header in every API request.
access.none: No API key yet. Create one to use the Public API.
access.needLogin: You need to sign in to create an API key.
access.confirmRevoke: Revoke the API key? Integrations using this key will be disconnected.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.subtitle: Default download settings — synced with your account
prefs.watermarkDesc: Turned on automatically when downloading TikTok / Douyin
prefs.subsDesc: Includes .srt if the video has subtitles

devices.title: My devices
devices.desc: Your account can be used on up to {{max}} devices. The website, extension and app on the same computer count as 1 device. When the limit is exceeded, the least recently used device is signed out.
devices.confirmCurrent: This is the device you are using. Signing out will also sign you out of VidGrab here. Continue?
devices.empty: No devices recorded yet. The list updates after you use VidGrab while signed in.
devices.error: Could not load the device list. Please try again.
devices.actionError: Could not sign out the device. Please try again.
